programme.desc: 'S3/E20'. Iemand onverwags daag by die blommemark op. Christine tree roekeloos op om haar myn se toekoms te verseker. Amber en Junior maak 'n skokontdekking.

programme.title: Klaskamer 10
programme.desc: 'S10/E65'. Werner behandel graad 12 fisiese wetenskappe konsepte.

programme.title: Wanderlus
programme.desc: 'S4/E4'. Hennie en Nicole toer verder in Namibië met vele avonture op hul pad en besoek die Etosha Nasionale park. Hul toer eindig net buite Windhoek waar hulle toor met interessante wildsvleis snitte.

programme.title: Overbergbewoners
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Judith Balie & Clinton Lerm'. Ons kuier by Judith Balie, passievolle museumbestuurder van die Genadendal Sendingsmuseum. Dan wys Clinton Lerm, eienaar van SA Forest Adventures, vir ons K3, die wêreld se langste ziplyn.

programme.title: Stralend
programme.desc: 'S2/E12'. In hierdie episode word Angelique behoorlik verras. Die spesiale gas is die keer iemand wat sy baie goed ken. Fafa besluit om die oorhand te neem en almal leer oor die waarde van familie.

programme.title: Banana Air
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Sakkie vier sy egskeiding. Hester is woedend oor Piston se leuens. Rodney se video's verskyn op sosiale media, en Barbie en Piston word saam in 'n Jacuzzi betrap.

programme.title: Binnelanders
programme.desc: 'S15/E45'. Danie en Nicolette beweeg al nader aan mekaar. Riekie wil haar pa verras vir sy verjaarsdag, en Delia en Conrad se verhouding beland op die rotse ná 'n intense raadsvergadering.

programme.title: Reënboogrant
programme.desc: 'S1/E34 - Anderkant Die Reënboog'. Opgewondenheid heers oor die premier van Anderkant Die Reënboog. Shani worstel met haar gevoelens vir Chris. Rachelle woeker voort met haar slinkse planne om vir Shani te verneder.

programme.title: Suidooster
programme.desc: 'S12/E88'. Kate hoor iets skokkend, terwyl Amanda vir Mike van Frankie se onderhoud vertel. Lee-Ann nooi Zahra vir aandete en Zoe het slegte nuus vir Gary.

programme.title: eNuus
programme.desc: 'S17/E123'. Daaglikse nuushooftrekke, sporthoogtepunte en weervooruitskouing in Afrikaans.

programme.title: Ander Dam Se Eende
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Die ouens ervaar 'n emosionele stop by Graceland, Bealestraat se Blues musiek, straatkunstenaars, en 'n verrassende slang-oomblik langs die Mississippi.

programme.title: Toks & Tjops
programme.desc: 'S16/E17'. Een ding is seker, Suid-Afrikaners is mal daaroor om te braai en rugby te kyk! Ons paneelprogram verken alle sportgebeure wat die vorige week plaasgevind het en die wat elke naweek voorlê.

programme.title: Stralend
programme.desc: 'S2/E13'. Die finale episode is hier en al 12 gaste is in die kollig. Ons gesels oor alles, van waar hulle nou is tot wat die toekoms inhou. Gebroke harte, vrese, nuwe belangstellings en nog meer.

programme.title: Besigheid Op 'n Bord
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Nick Oosthuizen besoek Mardouw-olyfplaas en La Mont, 'n suiwelboerdery, om bestanddele vir sy driegangmaaltyd te vind. Hy wil die beoordelaars oortuig hy's die geskikte kandidaat om Just Amy te bestuur.

programme.title: Nisboere
programme.desc: 'S10/E17'. Ons reis die land vol om innoverende landbou-entrepreneurs te ontmoet wat woeker op 'n klein stukkie grond.

programme.desc: 'S1/E8'. Geen filters. Geen perfekte profielfoto's. Net 'n groep mense wat hul wêreld oopmaak en wys wie hulle werklik is wanneer niemand kyk nie.

programme.title: Piet braai padlangs
programme.desc: 'S1/E11'. Piet Marais reis deur die pragtige Wes-Kaap op soek na die beste bestanddele vir sy perfekte braai. Of hy jag, snuffel of visvang, elke episode eindig met 'n heerlike gereg wat hy self oor die vuur gebraai het.

programme.desc: 'S21/E6'. Ons gunstelingtydverdryf is nou 'n sosiale eksperiment. Drie paartjies wat mekaar nie ken nie, braai by mekaar en heelwat gebeur om die vuur.

programme.desc: 'S12/E11'. In dié geselsprogram nooi die akteur Frank Rautenbach gaste om oor dinge te praat wat hom interesseer en inspireer. Van karre, visvang, jag, beleggings, reis en rugby - álles wat die manne na aan die hart lê.

programme.title: The Curse Of Skinwalker Ranch
programme.desc: 'S3/E2 - Tic Tac 2'. The team invites former members of the U.S. military connected to the infamous 'Tic Tac' UAP encounter, and are stunned when they stimulate very similar phenomena to appear above Skinwalker Ranch.

programme.title: The Lost Secrets Of Jesus
programme.desc: The Lost Secrets of Jesus is a documentary that peels back the layers of centuries-old tradition and artistic interpretation to reveal the real historical and archaeological evidence behind the life of Jesus.

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Barbarossa'. The story of Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's massive surprise invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, the largest and costliest land offensive in human history.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E13 - San Brandi-Dino!'. Brandi is fired up about expanding her brand in San Bernardino. Rene is positive that everyone is out to get him. Dusty tackles a locker dustier than him. Kenny... well he's just a mess.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E14 - Your Pawpaw Loves You!'. Lisa returns to Moreno Valley, where it all started, and gets nostalgic with her locker. Kenny welcomes a new granddaughter to the clan and would love to find an appropriate unit.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E15 - Strings & Beans'. Ivy takes on a supervisory role in Stanton and it leads him to a bit of Slavic success. Brandi tries to help Danielle outfit her new apartment. Lisa gambles on a painting.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S16/E3 - Chaos Before The Storm'. Troy and Pickle head to Lake Fausse Pointe, where they hope to fill the boat in this under fished area. Ronnie is forced to hunt solo after Timmy becomes ill.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S16/E4 - Hurricane Francine'. As Hurricane Francine strikes with full force, hunters face the dual challenge of navigating a dangerous storm and preserving their season.

programme.title: The Lost Secrets Of Jesus
programme.desc: The Lost Secrets of Jesus is a documentary that peels back the layers of centuries-old tradition and artistic interpretation to reveal the real historical and archaeological evidence behind the life of Jesus.

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Barbarossa'. The story of Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's massive surprise invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, the largest and costliest land offensive in human history.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Road To Burma'. The expansion of the Japanese empire had as its main aim the conquest of territories rich in natural resources. And so Japan cast its eyes towards South East Asia.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Desert War'. Meanwhile in North Africa, the Italian dictator Mussolini had his own ideas about building a new Roman Empire in the region. And so he sent thousands of poorly-trained and ill-prepared Italian troops.

programme.title: Truthseekers
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Bermuda Triangle'. A region in the North Atlantic Ocean defined by points in Bermuda. Reports of unexplained occurrences, vanishings of ships and planes, in the region date to the mid-19th century.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E11 - Beat The Unbeaten: A Cutlass Above'. For the first time in Forged in Fire history, two champions will return for the opportunity to go head to head against one of our titans of the forge.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E12 - Beat The Unbeaten: Off The Hook'. Two previous champions will face off in a gruelling 5-hour challenge, making a blade inspired by Hollywood for the chance to duke it out against one of our titans of the forge.

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: 'S20/E1 - Classic Car Cemetery'. In South Carolina, the Wolfe brothers pick a main street grocery that's frozen in time, and pay a visit to Sammy's classic car paradise.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E16 - Pin Up Or Shut Up'. Dusty and Lupe pedal their way to an auction in Fullerton, but end up needing the truck. Darrell pins his hopes on a small locker for which he overpaid.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E17 - Rock, Paper, Winner'. Back in Montebello, Gunter comes along to 'help' Rene, who won't give him the time of day. Darrell tries to make Kimber his queen, while Ivy and his boys Rochambeau their way to solid showing.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E18 - Does A Bear Bid In The Woods?'. Kenny makes his way out to the mountains, watching out for cougars the whole time. Lisa scores on a small sister locker, but it's Brandi who gets the nomination for buyer of the week.

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David...
programme.desc: 'Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny. S2/E4 - Black Ops'. Victory is often forged in the shadows. A French Resistance operative hides explosives in baguettes and Ukrainian forces deploy AI-guided drones to strike a Russian fleet.

programme.title: The Curse Of Oak Island
programme.desc: 'S13/E24 - Road Trip'. New revelations are made about the sand and stone road in the swamp as a discovery in the Money Pit suggests that answers to the Oak Island mystery may be found over 2000 miles away.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Hell In The Pacific'. This episode remembers some of the thunderous naval battles which took place during the Pacific war.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: 'S1/E9 - Eastern Front'. The decision by Hitler to send his armies east in to Russia was probably the most significant of the war. Now against military convention, he was fighting on two fronts.

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Mad Medicine'. Ever taken medical advice from a cigarette commercial? There was a time when any and all 'cures' could be sold to the public indiscriminately.

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Very Extreme Sports'. The modern concept of 'extreme sports' is a product of marketing, but back in the old days, the rules (or lack thereof) of our nation's sports made them truly extreme.

programme.title: Suzuki at Simola: Climb to Survive
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Four drivers. One iconic hill. Zero room for error. Follow Sam from the Car Scene, Girlie the sim racer, Top Gear's Avon & IGNITION's Cool Car Chic as they take on Simola Hillclimb.

programme.title: Trace, Track, Get My Car Back
programme.desc: 'S1/E11'. At Felixstowe, intelligence officer Adam finds a stolen car wedged into the back of a shipping container. On the back seat, there are children's toys, including a teddy bear.

programme.title: IGNITION GT
programme.desc: 'S26/E31'. Ignition GT gives you the lowdown on the latest and hottest new cars releases from our local market, but also from the international circuit.

programme.title: Cape Route Rally
programme.desc: 'S3/E10'. The crew mounts up for day 3 as Louis points the convoy towards the best gravel roads in South Africa. Ant puts his Cooper Tyres to the test, & we make a return to Gravel Kings.

programme.title: Just To See How Far It Is
programme.desc: 'S3/E8'. Wild, wet and wonderful is the only way to describe our camping experience on top of Sibebe Rock before heading south to a new camp spot in the incredible Ngwempisi Wilderness area.

programme.title: Champions of the Future Academy...

programme.title: The Bike Show

programme.title: The Greatest - Instant Impact

programme.title: The Greatest - Instant Impact
programme.desc: 'S26/E6 of 6 - Episode 6: The Last Chapter'. Moving to Yamaha for 2024-2025 after nine years with Kawasaki, Rea battles injuries and setbacks before deciding to step away from full-time racing... or does he?

programme.title: The Greatest - Instant Impact
programme.desc: 'S26/E3 of 6 - Episode 3: Resilience'. Overcoming a massive early-season deficit to Alvaro Bautista in 2019, Rea relies on grit and consistency to mount one of the greatest comebacks in WorldSBK history for his fifth title.

programme.title: The Greatest - Instant Impact
programme.desc: 'S26/E4 of 6 - Episode 4: Respect'. Rea's six-year championship streak ends in 2021 after an intense, season-long duel with Yamaha's Toprak Razgatlioglu, decided in a thrilling finale in Mandalika, Indonesia.

programme.title: The Greatest - Instant Impact
programme.desc: 'S26/E5 of 6 - Episode 5: Behind The 65'. A look beyond the track, at the family, team and inner circle whose support shaped Jonathan Rea's career and built the champion behind the famous number 65.

programme.title: The Greatest - Instant Impact
programme.desc: 'S26/E6 of 6 - Episode 6: The Last Chapter'. Moving to Yamaha for 2024-2025 after nine years with Kawasaki, Rea battles injuries and setbacks before deciding to step away from full-time racing... or does he?
